record.original_question: Is there at least one closed magnetic geodesic in every positive energy level?

evidence.quote: Is there at least one closed magnetic geodesic in every positive energy level?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a closed (compact, without boundary) connected Riemannian manifold and let $\sigma$ be a closed 2-form on $M$, called the magnetic form. The magnetic form induces a bundle map $Y:TM\to TM$ via $g(Y(v),w)=\sigma(v,w)$ for all $v,w\in T_xM$. A smooth curve $\gamma:\mathbb{R}\to M$ is called a magnetic geodesic for $(g,\sigma)$ if it satisfies the equation
$$\nabla_{\dot\gamma}\dot\gamma = Y(\dot\gamma),$$
where $\nabla$ is the Levi-Civita connection of $g$. Magnetic geodesics have constant kinetic energy $E(\gamma)=\tfrac{1}{2}|\dot\gamma|_g^2$, so they preserve every energy level $\{E=k\}$ for $k>0$. A magnetic geodesic is called closed if it is non-constant and periodic.

Question: Does there exist, for every closed Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$, every closed 2-form $\sigma$ on $M$, and every $k>0$, at least one closed magnetic geodesic with energy $k$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether every positive energy level admits a closed magnetic geodesic is generally regarded as still open. Recent works (e.g., Asselle–Benedetti and follow-up papers from 2023–2025) confirm existence on low energy levels under curvature hypotheses, on almost every subcritical energy level, and on energies above the Mañé critical value, but the full problem on every positive energy level for arbitrary closed manifolds and magnetic forms remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Magnetic curvature and existence of a closed magnetic geodesic on low energy levels
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of a contractible periodic orbit on every energy level close to zero under positive magnetic Ricci curvature; full problem at all positive energies not settled.
status_evidence.claim: Existence is established only on low energy levels under curvature hypotheses, indicating the general problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Open problems and questions about geodesics (Burns–Matveev)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists existence of closed magnetic geodesics on every energy level among open problems related to geodesic flows.
status_evidence.claim: The question is listed among open problems on geodesics.

status_evidence.title: The growth rate of closed prime magnetic geodesics on closed contact manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes growth rates only on energy levels where existence is known, leaving general existence open.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature still treats existence at all positive energies as not generally established.
